content: BallonsTranslator (dmMaze, GPL-3.0, PyQt6, 5k stars) - the reference open-source manga typesetting tool. TextBlkItem = QGraphicsTextItem subclass with per-orientation custom QAbstractTextDocumentLayout (VerticalTextDocumentLayout/HorizontalTextDocumentLayout) swapped via doc.setDocumentLayout; FontFormat dataclass (font family/size/weight/bold/italic/color/stroke color+width/shadow radius+strength+color+offset/gradient/opacity/alignment/letter+line spacing); setVertical() swaps layouts preserving effect padding; Ctrl+A selects all text blocks (multi-select); alignment is horizontal-only [left,center,right]; squeezeBoundingRect = fit-to-box; export renders the same items into the page image with set_export_effect_render(True) + higher render_scale - the 'single visual truth' bake pattern (exactly D-01's contract). Confirms: custom layout is production-proven for vertical manga text, effects are paint/raster-based with caching, bake reuses the live renderer at 1:1.
